stopped_because: Perplexity free-search limit reached at query B9: 'Sie haben Ihr Limit für kostenlose Suchen erreicht. Der Zugang wird in einigen Stunden zurückgesetzt.' The 2026-08-23 baseline hit the same wall at 13 of 18.
detection_method: Citation counted only when 'openappindex' appears inside the <main> answer element or in a source URL within it. A naive document-body check gives FALSE POSITIVES: the left sidebar lists recent searches, which included the 13:24 retrieval probe named 'openAPPindex Rezept-Apps Index'. This was caught and excluded; every verdict below uses the main-scoped test.
confound_introduced_today: The retrieval probe run at 13:24 on this same logged-in account placed the string 'openAPPindex' into the account's search history before these queries ran. If Perplexity personalises retrieval on history, it can only bias TOWARD citing us. The run returned zero citations, so the direction of the bias does not affect this result — but a future positive result on this account must be discounted for it, or run on a clean session.
